source._comment: Maine SoS 'Voter Data' page links the Statewide Absentee Voter Data File (pipe-delimited text, one row per request, town-level with party, CG, SS/SR/CC and Status) and the Registered and Enrolled file (xlsx by county/municipality/ward-precinct/CG with active voters by party). me_update.py places towns in counties via the R&E list; township_counties covers unorganized townships the R&E list doesn't name where the district match is ambiguous.
source.township_counties_source: Hancock County, 'A Letter to UT Landowners' (https://hancockcountymaine.gov/unorganized-territory/letter-to-landowners/)
